items.title: Allegion (ALLE) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Mixed Analyst Target Changes
items.summary: Allegion’s updated analyst fair value estimate has shifted from about US$164 to roughly US$169.82 per share, sitting within a wider range of recent price targets that span roughly US$142 to US$170. This change lines up with Street commentary that is split between higher targets from bullish firms after Q2 results and lower targets from more cautious analysts who question how much investors should pay for the stock. items.summary: Allegion stock has delivered a 39.4% return over the past three years, yet its valuation signals are mixed. items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. But their prominence also brings high exposure to the ups and downs of economic cycles.
